cases.title: SPA Shell, Research Overview KPI Cards & Backend Telemetry Rendering
cases.description: Navigates to http://127.0.0.1:3240/, verifies Sidebar, Header, Academic Prototype banner, and live Overview metrics from GET /api/overview.
cases.assertion_text: assert Sidebar visible && Overview KPI metrics rendered
cases.logs: Research Overview rendered with live portfolio metrics and zero uncaught exceptions.

cases.title: Synthetic Data Laboratory Form Controls & Data Dictionary Modal Inspection
cases.description: Navigates to Synthetic Data Lab, verifies ChaCha8 badge, profile selector (Small/Medium/Large), seed input, and Data Dictionary modal.
cases.preconditions: At least 1 seeded dataset in research_datasets.
cases.assertion_text: assert SyntheticLabPage form controls and dataset registry table render
cases.logs: Synthetic Data Lab UI controls and dataset registry verified in headless Chromium.

cases.title: Customer Explorer Search, 8-Profile Filter & Customer 360 Feature Vector Modal
cases.description: Tests Customer Explorer profile filtering, cohort filtering, customer table rendering, and 360-degree detail modal inspection.
cases.assertion_text: assert customer table renders && profile filter updates && 360 modal opens
cases.logs: Customer Explorer filters and 360 detail inspection verified in headless Chromium.

cases.title: Bilingual Transaction NLP Interactive Classification & Confusion Matrix View
cases.description: Submits Indonesian transaction narrative in NlpIntelligencePage and verifies predicted category, confidence bar, and evaluation metrics.
cases.assertion_text: assert Classify button returns 'Salary / Income' with confidence score
cases.logs: NLP interactive classification and evaluation metrics verified in headless Chromium.

cases.title: Credit Risk Decision Support PD Evaluation & Underwriter Review Table
cases.description: Triggers customer credit risk evaluation in CreditAssessmentPage and verifies PD score, risk category, and assessment history table.
cases.assertion_text: assert PD score, risk_category, and recommendation render in UI
cases.logs: Credit Risk Decision Support evaluation executed in headless Chromium.

cases.title: Explainable AI (XAI) Workspace Local SHAP Waterfall & Global Importance View
cases.description: Navigates to Explainable AI Workspace and verifies SHAP waterfall attribution bars, global feature ranking, and non-causal academic disclaimer.
cases.preconditions: At least one credit assessment exists.
cases.assertion_text: assert XaiWorkspacePage renders SHAP waterfall and global feature importance
cases.logs: XAI Workspace rendered local and global SHAP visualizations in headless Chromium.

cases.title: Dynamic Risk Monitoring Event Simulation & PSI Drift Surveillance View
cases.description: Verifies DynamicMonitoringPage event simulation controls, longitudinal PD trajectory, and PSI feature drift table.
cases.assertion_text: assert DynamicMonitoringPage renders event simulator and PSI drift table
cases.logs: Dynamic Risk Monitoring and PSI Drift view verified in headless Chromium.

cases.title: Model Lab, Benchmark Comparison, Fairness Audit, Experiment History & System Diagnostics Navigation
cases.description: Navigates through Model Lab, Model Comparison, Fairness & Bias Audit, Experiment History, and System Settings & Diagnostics, verifying data rendering on each page.
cases.assertion_text: assert modelLabOk && modelCompOk && fairnessOk && expOk && settingsOk
cases.logs: All 5 modeling, fairness, audit trail, and system diagnostics pages rendered accurately.

cases.title: Autonomous QA & Audit Dashboard UI, 12-Module Matrix, Remediation Modal & Responsive Viewport
cases.description: Verifies QaAuditDashboardPage KPI cards, findings list, test case explorer, 12-module coverage matrix, schedules, and responsive layout.
cases.preconditions: QA Engine initialized and accessible at /api/qa/overview.
cases.logs: QA & Audit Dashboard verified with 0 console errors and 0 failed network requests.
